info.name: BrandFlow — Frame Blueprints Collection
info.description: API endpoints for transparent PNG overlay frames with vector element configuration JSON schemas.

request.description: Fetches paginated list of 30+ categorized vector frames with dynamic configuration schemas.
Fetches a single frame configuration schema by ID.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Minimalist Corporate Frame",
  "description": "Clean lower-third badge with avatar ring, phone, and business name slots.",

  "configJson": {
    "elements": [
      {
        "id": "shape_1",
        "type": "CAPSULE",
        "slotCategory": "STATIC_SHAPE",
        "x": 200,

        "fillColor": "#1E293B",
        "borderWidth": 0
      },
      {
        "id": "avatar_1",

        "slotCategory": "IMAGE_SLOT",
        "dynamicSlot": "AVATAR_CIRCLE",
        "customLabel": "Profile Photo",
        "x": 215,

      {
        "id": "text_phone",

request.description: Uploads transparent PNG overlay and persists frame blueprint. (Admin / Frames tab)
Deletes a frame blueprint and cleans up images from Cloudinary.
